about.title: Laguna Hills Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Laguna Hills recorded 140 injury collisions and 2 traffic deaths in the most recent final crash year, numbers that represent real families whose lives changed in an instant. When a crash on I-5, Alicia Parkway, Paseo De Valencia, or Moulton Parkway takes a spouse, parent, or child, the grief is only compounded by unanswered questions about what happens next. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim, though the window to act is limited. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect grieving families in Laguna Hills with an independent attorney who can review what happened, explain available options, and handle the legal work while you focus on your family. There's no fee unless the attorney recovers something on your behalf. Reaching out costs nothing and starts with a conversation, not a commitment.

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to specific people, usually a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. An attorney can clarify where your family fits before any claim moves forward.

items.title: A Strict Two-Year Clock
items.desc: California generally requires a wrongful death claim within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity is involved. Waiting to get guidance can quietly cost a family its legal options.

items.title: Losses the Law Recognizes
items.desc: Wrongful death claims can account for funeral and burial costs, lost financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. An independent attorney can help explain how these losses apply to your situation.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, registered domestic partner, and children. If none of those exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing under certain circumstances. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and explain who qualifies to bring the claim.

items.question: Does a Laguna Hills wrongful death case relate to any criminal charges from the crash?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal case that may be filed against a driver. The civil case focuses on financial and emotional losses to the family, not criminal punishment, and it moves on its own timeline regardless of what happens criminally.

items.question: How much time do we have to act after losing someone in a Laguna Hills crash?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though that deadline can be much shorter if a government agency, such as a public road authority, is involved. Given how corridors like Moulton Parkway and I-5 see regular collision activity, getting an early legal review helps ensure the deadline isn't missed.
